wording.why: Players may offer Dr. Mundo (period) or Nunu & Willump (ampersand) as 'punctuation'; only an apostrophe counts. An example would make that instant.
wording.suggestion: The champion's official name contains an apostrophe ('), e.g. Kai'Sa. Other punctuation (Dr. Mundo, Nunu & Willump) doesn't count.

aliases.why: Short form matching the other Void champions' aliases (Cho, Kha, Kog, Rek, Bel).

fun.why: Only 8 answers and the 'Void names have apostrophes' shortcut lets veterans name nearly all; K'Sante is the one real trap, so the rare end is thin.

champion:Chogath.why: Classic Void name, first to mind.

champion:Khazix.why: Very popular jungler, apostrophe is part of his identity.

champion:Velkoz.why: Known but low play; still reached by a Void scan.

champion:RekSai.why: Niche jungler; often forgotten in a Void scan.

champion:KSante.why: Not Void, and the apostrophe follows a single letter; widely forgotten.

gemCandidates.why: Maintainer's suggestion holds: the only non-Void answer, a clear 'oh of course' when revealed. Typicality 0.15, lowest in the set.
Newest Void champion, often missed in the scan; 0.22, bottom half.
Low-play jungler players forget; 0.22, bottom half.
